title: Count the updates
statement_md:
`steps_per_epoch(n, batch)` already counts the batches in one pass, rounding up because the last batch may be partial.

Add `count_updates(n, batch, epochs)` returning the number of parameter updates in a full run:

`ceil(n / batch) * epochs`

- return `0` when `n` or `epochs` is `0`
- raise `ValueError` when `batch < 1` or `epochs < 0`
- return an `int`

Do not change `steps_per_epoch`.
